payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the GM_KL approach with other WSD methods using word embeddings, highlighting its advantages in handling polysemy and performance on benchmark datasets.

claims.text: The GM_KL approach outperforms previous models like w2g and w2gm in word similarity and entailment tasks.
Previous models do not effectively handle polysemous words, while GM_KL uses a Gaussian mixture model to better capture multiple meanings.
GM_KL employs a KL divergence based energy function, which is an improvement over traditional methods that fail to consider entailment relations.
